name: OpenSearch
label: OpenSearch — Amazon OpenSearch Service (SigV4)
description: Amazon OpenSearch Service domain REST APIs signed with AWS SigV4 (service es). Set endpoint to the domain hostname (search-mydomain-abc.{region}.es.amazonaws.com). Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/managedomains-signing-service-requests.html and https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/. OpenSearch Serverless uses signing service aoss (not supported by this node; use the generic AWS or HTTP Request node). Self-hosted OpenSearch with HTTP Basic should use the HTTP Request node. Customer owns the index data. Secrets never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_key_id, secret_access_key, or session_token here. Example: {"operation":"document.create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT: document.create | document.get | document.update | document.delete | document.search.

schema.label: doc
schema.description: Partial document for document.update. Pair with doc_as_upsert when inserting on miss (https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/api-reference/document-apis/update-document/).

schema.label: upsert
schema.description: document.update optional upsert document when the id is missing. Example: {"status":"new"}.

schema.label: refresh
schema.description: document.create/update/delete query. EXACT: true | false | wait_for. Example: wait_for.

schema.label: doc_as_upsert
schema.description: If true, uses doc for both update and insert. Official Update Document API.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Secrets never copied here.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: document.create | document.get | document.update | document.delete | document.search.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4 for the OpenSearch domain. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS region
configurationParameters.description: SigV4 signing region of the OpenSearch domain (e.g. us-east-1). Must match the domain.

configurationParameters.label: Domain endpoint host
configurationParameters.description: OpenSearch domain hostname without scheme, e.g. search-mydomain-abc.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com. OfficialApiNode calls https://{endpoint}.
